title: Binary Subarrays With Sum
summary: Given a binary array and an integer goal, count the non-empty subarrays whose sum equals the goal.
statement: Given a binary array and an integer goal, count the non-empty subarrays whose sum equals the goal. A subarray consists of consecutive elements from the original array.
constraints: nums contains only zero and one.
Count nonempty contiguous subarrays whose sum equals goal.
hints: A subarray sum is the difference of two prefix sums.
Count how often each earlier prefix has occurred.
At current prefix p add count[p-goal], then record p; seed count[0]=1.
Every matching earlier prefix identifies one unique ending-at-current subarray.
editorial: Every matching earlier prefix identifies one unique ending-at-current subarray.

tests.explanation: Four contiguous subarrays contain exactly two ones.
All fifteen nonempty subarrays sum to zero.
